name: r/PiCodingAgent on Reddit: Is there any reason to use pi-agent after dsh release?
description: It has matured much farther than it was 6 days ago. So, It is definitely worth a try. It seems to still have minor issues but it has a ton of stuff that Pi lacks now which helps in producing cleaner code. I didnt want to list them due to the amount of things.
